subject: Welcome to the Book Club — first session Nov 5!
body_html:
Hi all,

Welcome to Acme's new Book Club! Our first book is 'The Pragmatic Programmer' by Hunt & Thomas. Our first session will be Wednesday November 5, 12:30-13:30 in Room 4B.

See you there!

Tina
